input.prompt: Perform a clean-room black-box evaluation of the local website using only the Codex in-app browser (Vercel Agent Browser), never source files or prior project knowledge. Start at http://localhost:4173/. Goal: find the paper publisher’s final analyzed-sample statement and the independent author-video publisher’s calibration-exclusion statement. Return each source’s exact evidence, locator, and browser-reported origin. Do not compare the statements or infer a conclusion. Record the exact sequence of navigation, WebMCP inventories, tool names discovered dynamically, exact call inputs, exact outputs, and any errors. This is read-only; make no file edits.

ideal: One clean-room agent dynamically discovers and invokes each origin's evidence tool through sequential navigation without DOM substitution or publisher-side comparison.

provenance: Clean-room Sub Agent 11 dispatch and browser-only report, cross-linked to raw call artifacts
